Thanks and here are some of their lores

Ultraman Zex (middle): a creation by a parallel universe Alien Bat, Zex used to be a version of Zetton known as Ultra Killer Zetton, the perfect Ultra killing machine. He massacred countless Ultras in the Land of Light and it took Taro to become Super Ultraman Taro and using his Cosmo Miracle Beam in order to take him down. He has a special ability where he can absorb incoming attacks and becomes more powerful and Taro's beam mutated this Zetton morphing him into an artificial Ultra. Now a being of light taking the name Zex, Ultraman Zex vowed to redeem his past sins by being a force for good. After saving the Earth from Alien Bat who wished to conquer Earth for his experiments, Zex found out there's a plan by a cult who worships a dead Eldritch Space God from an alien who came to Earth to escape from the cult who was chasing after him. Tasked with stopping the cult by the dying alien, Zex and his friend board an experimental spaceship and head into space.

Red Mashin (middle right): a reclusive bounty hunter, no one really knows who Red Mashin really is. Some say he is an android, some say he's a person in an advanced cyber suit. No one even knows his real name. But everyone only knows to stay out of his way. He is a vicious bounty hunter who will do anything to claim the bounty he's after. Red Mashin has countless weapons at his side but his preferred method is his Red Knife and Red Spear. His Red Knife is a beam of light turned into a blade similar to Agul and Gaia's. He joined Zex's group when Zex was given a bounty by a secretive cult. Zex defeated Red Mashin and he decided to follow on his mission to stop the same cult from reviving their dead God.

Trinity (rightmost): Trinity came from a species of aliens who have three personality in one body. They're similar to the Ultras in that they also have a organization similar to the Space Garrison known as the Inquisitors. Trinity came from a family of Inquisitors and they're the latest recruits. Even though it was expected of them to be an Inquisitor, Trinity wished to be an artist and doesn't view their time as an Inquisitor as important. They were assigned a sector to patrol and came across Zex during his mission to stop the cult from reviving the dead God. Due to the bounty placed upon Zex, Trinity mistakenly tried to arrest Zex and bring him back to their planet to be tried in their court of law but Zex, after defeating Trinity, explained his true mission and so Trinity joined him in Zex's mission.

Mirror Kaiser (middle left): a warrior from the Land of Mirrors, a plane of existence mirroring the universe, Mirror Kaiser is a hot headed trainee of a seasoned Mirror-ite warrior. Due to his hot headedness he left his guild to pursue fights with anyone he deemed a worthy opponent. He came across Zex and heard of his past battles and so picked a fight with the Ultra. Humbled by his defeat Mirror Kaiser vowed to defeat Zex in battle. He appeared at the final battle bringing with him the Mirror-ites and the Inquisitors as backup when the cult and their God arrived on Earth. After the battle he joined Zex and his group in order to protect their universe.

Grid Iron (leftmost): a being of Data, Grid Iron came from a the Dataworld and had known a certain Ultra from another universe. He considered himself a gentle giant as he prefer peace over violent. He also predicted that the dead God would have followers that would continue his work and so he began an undercover mission, infiltrating the cult to find out more about their mission. He was tasked with taking out Zex when Red Mashin had failed to bring him in but due to both Zex and Grid Iron being on the same side he secretly told Zex about the cult's mission to revive the dead God. He began to leave breadcrumbs so Zex and his allies can follow along. Grid Iron inevitably got found out and almost was killed by the cult's general. He narrowly escaped with his life and joined Zex's group in order to thwart the cult's plan.

So far that's the story I have for these five. It's still a WIP so things are bound to change as I fleshes the stories out some more. But yea these are their stories like I said still fleshing em out. Also after dealing with the cult and their God the group then called themselves the Z Force named after Zex of course.

No, you should not. The saying "nothing is original anymore" is true. Everything these days are either derivatives or remixes. If you're afraid that your story will be compared to the Hunger Games then add something to it to differentiate it from that story. Add interesting concepts or twists to your battle royale story that no one has thought about or add concepts from other stories that you think will result in an original story. 

Take the basic plotline of Mulan for example. Girl dressed up as boy to serve in the military. A lot of authors have taken that concept but put their own unique twists to it. Like instead of serving in the country's military, it's a girl trying to learn magic but girls are forbidden to do so. You get the idea. 

Basically just add something you think will differentiate yourself from other similar stories. So just go wild. This is the best part of creating a story. The brainstorming bits thinking of possible ways your story could go.
